title: Director of Technology Operations
description:
**COMPANY DESCRIPTION:**

Zamorins Solutions is a growing software company founded in 2014 in Des Moines, Iowa, with a strong delivery center in Kakkanad, Kochi, Kerala. We began as a web development firm and have expanded into mobile development, business analysis, digital marketing, and our own SaaS products serving clients across North America and beyond. We are looking for a hands-on technology leader to own three core areas: technology operations with strong database and AI capabilities,
day-to-day operations for
our Kochi office, and HR management for our team.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**
**:**

* Drive the adoption of AI across our products and internal workflows, turning AI from an idea into working features and measurable time savings.
* Run the Kochi office: daily operations and attendance, so the team stays productive and accountable.
* Own HR management for the Kochi team, from hiring and onboarding to performance, policies, and employee well-being.
* Act as a trusted partner to the CEO, owning execution so leadership can stay focused on growth and strategy.



**WHAT YOU WILL OWN:**

* **Database leadership:**

  design, manage, and optimize relational and cloud databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, Supabase or similar); own data modeling, query performance, backups, replication, and disaster recovery.
* **AI and data initiatives:**

  lead the design and delivery of AI features using LLMs (OpenAI, Claude, or similar), including prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector databases, AI agents, and workflow automation; evaluate new AI tools and guide responsible use.
* **Technology operations:**

  oversee infrastructure, cloud environments (AWS, Azure, Vercel, or similar), deployments, monitoring, uptime, and IT service management (incident, problem, and change processes).
* **Project and delivery management:**

  plan, prioritize, and track technology initiatives using agile methods; manage timelines, sprint goals, deliverables, and quality across product and client projects.
* **Daily operations:**

  manage day-to-day office functioning, work schedules, resource allocation, vendor relationships, and IT assets so work runs smoothly every day.
* **Attendance management:**

  monitor daily attendance, punctuality, leave, and work-from-office compliance; maintain accurate records and share regular attendance reports with leadership.
* **HR management:**

  own the full employee lifecycle: workforce planning, recruitment, interviews, onboarding, and exit processes.
* **HR policies and compliance:**

  create, update, and enforce HR policies, the employee handbook, and leave rules; ensure compliance with Indian labor laws, PF, ESI, and gratuity requirements.
* **Performance and payroll:**

  run goal setting, appraisals, and performance improvement plans; maintain employee records and prepare accurate monthly payroll inputs.
* **Employee relations:**

  handle employee concerns and grievances fairly and promptly; drive engagement, training, and retention initiatives.
* **Security and compliance:**

  enforce data security, access control, and backup policies; support risk management and compliance practices across systems and client data.
* **Team leadership:**

  lead, mentor, and motivate developers and technical staff; build a culture of ownership, learning, and continuous improvement.
* **Reporting and metrics:**

  track performance KPIs for systems, projects, and people; prepare clear weekly reports for the CEO.



**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

* Proven experience in a senior technology, IT operations, or engineering leadership role, preferably in a software or digital services company.
* Strong, hands-on database expertise: SQL, schema design, performance tuning, and administration of production databases.
* Practical AI experience: has built or shipped AI-powered features or automations using LLM APIs, RAG, vector databases, or machine learning tools.
* Solid knowledge of IT service management, cloud infrastructure, and modern development practices (Git, CI/CD, APIs).
* Strong HR management experience: hiring, onboarding, attendance and leave management, performance appraisals, payroll coordination, and employee relations.
* Working knowledge of Indian labour laws and statutory requirements (PF, ESI, gratuity, Shops and Establishments Act).
* Data Science skills: data analysis, Python or R, data visualization, and applying machine learning to business problems.
* Strong project management and analytical skills; able to read data, diagnose issues, and make sound decisions quickly.
* Familiarity with security, compliance, and risk management practices in IT environments.
* Excellent written and verbal communication in English, with the ability to work clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders and international teams. Fluency in Malayalam is preferred.
* PMP, ITIL, cloud, or AI certifications are a plus.
* **A positive, growth-oriented mindset:**

  you thrive in a fast-moving environment, bring solutions rather than excuses, and take ownership as if the business were your own.



**WHY JOIN ZAMORINS**

* Work on real SaaS products and client solutions used across North America.
* Lead AI adoption in a company that is actively investing in it.
* Direct partnership with the CEO and a clear path to grow with the business.
* A collaborative environment focused on continuous learning and innovation.



*This is a full on-site role requiring daily presence at our Kakkanad office. Candidates based in the Kochi area are strongly encouraged to apply.*

title: Senior System Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
Nuventure Connect is a global technology services company that is ISO 27001:2022 and SOC 2 certified, and fully GDPR compliant. The organization applies deep engineering and digital expertise to solve complex business challenges across the entire product value chain. Nuventure Connect delivers next-generation solutions, including intuitive software products, end-to-end IoT implementations, cloud infrastructure management, and managed hosting support. The company also provides industrial CAD services and scalable industrial solutions, supporting organizations of all sizes through agile methodologies. As a trusted technology partner, Nuventure Connect focuses on innovation, reliability, and long-term client success.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced
**Senior Systems Engineer**
with strong expertise in
**IBM Power Systems, IBM i (AS/400), AIX, storage, backup, and high availability solutions**
. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience managing enterprise infrastructure, troubleshooting complex issues, ensuring system availability, and supporting disaster recovery operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Install, configure, administer, and troubleshoot IBM i (AS/400), AIX, and IBM Power Systems environments.
* Manage IBM PowerVM virtualization, HMC, VIOS, LPARs, NPIV, vSCSI, and Live Partition Mobility.
* Administer high availability solutions, including PowerHA, MIMIX, and SAN replication.
* Manage enterprise storage infrastructure, including IBM FlashSystem, Dell EMC, NetApp, and SAN switches.
* Perform OS patching, upgrades, performance tuning, security hardening, and capacity planning.
* Administer backup and recovery solutions, including IBM BRMS, mksysb, savevg, and tape libraries.
* Support disaster recovery planning, testing, and restoration activities.
* Troubleshoot critical infrastructure incidents and provide L3 technical support.
* Automate administrative tasks using Shell scripting, Python, or Ansible.
* Maintain technical documentation, runbooks, and infrastructure procedures.

**Mandatory Skills & Qualifications**

* **Minimum 10 years of hands-on experience with IBM Power Systems environments.**
* **Strong expertise in IBM i (AS/400) and AIX administration.**
* **Hands-on experience with IBM PowerVM, HMC, VIOS, and LPAR management.**
* **Experience with PowerHA, MIMIX, and high availability/replication solutions**
  .
* Strong knowledge of enterprise SAN storage, Fibre Channel, and storage replication.
* Experience with IBM BRMS, enterprise backup, and disaster recovery.
* Proficiency in AIX LVM, JFS2, system performance tuning, and troubleshooting.
* Experience handling enterprise infrastructure incidents and production support.
* Strong communication, documentation, and problem-solving skills.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

* IBM FlashSystem, SAN Volume Controller, Dell EMC, and NetApp storage.
* Brocade or Cisco MDS SAN switches.
* Ansible, KornShell, Bash, Perl, or Python scripting.
* Db2 for i administration and performance monitoring.
* ServiceNow, Jira, and ITIL processes.
* Experience with SOX, PCI-DSS, and infrastructure security compliance.
* **Ideal Candidate:**
  A senior IBM Power Systems professional with 10+ years of experience in IBM i, AIX, virtualization, high availability, enterprise storage, backup, and disaster recovery, capable of independently managing complex production infrastructure.

title: FSRC-R and CT-RCT-ACTIMIZE and JAVA-SENIOR
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY GDS – RCT**
**Senior – Actimize & Java Engineering**
**Senior – Software Engineering**
**Experience: Strictly 4+ years**
**Mandatory eligibility:**
Candidates must have 4 or more years of relevant professional experience and hands-on experience in Actimize, Java, SQL, cloud, and the Financial Crime Compliance domain. Candidates below 4 years or without any mandatory skill or domain experience are not eligible.
  
  
**The opportunity**
Join a Financial Crime Technology team delivering enterprise solutions for global financial services clients. The role requires strong hands-on engineering capability across NICE Actimize, Java, advanced SQL, and cloud platforms, supported by practical Financial Crime Compliance domain knowledge. The successful candidate will contribute to solution design, development, integration, deployment, optimization, and production support while guiding junior engineers and working directly with technical and business stakeholders.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer with proven experience implementing or supporting NICE Actimize solutions and building Java-based services and integrations. The role involves working with customer, account, transaction, alert, case, and screening data across KYC, AML, Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions, and Fraud use cases. Cloud and domain experience are mandatory. AI skills are an added advantage for accelerating engineering, analytics, documentation, testing, and investigation-support use cases.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, configure, develop, enhance, and support NICE Actimize solutions and related Financial Crime applications.
* Build and maintain Java applications, microservices, REST APIs, batch components, and integration services.
* Develop complex and optimized SQL for data ingestion, transformation, reconciliation, alerting, investigation, and reporting use cases.
* Integrate Actimize with upstream and downstream systems, including customer, account, transaction, case-management, screening, and reporting platforms.
* Deploy and support applications and data workloads on Azure, AWS, or GCP using appropriate cloud-native services.
* Translate compliance requirements into technical designs, rules, scenarios, data mappings, interfaces, and acceptance criteria.
* Perform performance tuning, defect analysis, root-cause analysis, code reviews, unit testing, release support, and production troubleshooting.
* Ensure secure coding, auditability, data protection, logging, monitoring, version control, and CI/CD practices.
* Collaborate with compliance SMEs, solution architects, data engineers, QA teams, infrastructure teams, and client stakeholders.
* Provide technical guidance to junior team members and take ownership of assigned modules and delivery outcomes.

**Mandatory Skills**

* Actimize: Strong hands-on experience with NICE Actimize implementation, configuration, customization, integration, enhancement, or production support. Experience should relate to Financial Crime solutions such as Transaction Monitoring, AML, sanctions screening, fraud, alerting, or case management.
* Java: Strong hands-on development experience with Core Java, object-oriented programming, collections, exception handling, multithreading fundamentals, Spring Boot, microservices, and REST APIs.
* Advanced SQL: Strong command of complex joins, subqueries, common table expressions, window functions, aggregations, stored procedures, query optimization, reconciliation, and high-volume data analysis.
* Cloud: Mandatory hands-on experience with at least one cloud platform: Microsoft Azure, AWS, or GCP. Experience must include developing, deploying, integrating, monitoring, or supporting applications and data workloads in a cloud environment.
* Financial Crime domain: Mandatory delivery experience in one or more of KYC, AML, Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions, or Fraud, with working knowledge of alerts, cases, investigations, rules or scenarios, regulatory controls, and financial crime data.
* Engineering practices: Git, Maven or Gradle, unit testing, code review, debugging, secure development, CI/CD, logging, monitoring, and production support.

**Actimize and Financial Crime knowledge**

* Actimize platform: Practical understanding of Actimize solution components, data flows, interfaces, alert generation, case workflows, rule or scenario changes, deployment, and operational support.
* Transaction Monitoring / AML: Scenario logic, thresholds, segmentation, alert generation, tuning support, false-positive analysis, investigations, and regulatory reporting concepts.
* KYC / CDD / EDD: Customer onboarding, identity checks, customer risk rating, beneficial ownership, periodic review, remediation, and enhanced due diligence.
* Sanctions: Customer and payment screening, watchlists, potential-match handling, disposition workflows, and screening data quality.
* Fraud: Fraud indicators, rules or models, event and transaction analysis, alert triage, investigations, and case outcomes.

**AI Skills – Added Advantage**

* Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot or equivalent for code generation, refactoring, testing, and documentation, with appropriate human review and secure-use practices.
* Understanding of generative AI and large language model concepts, including prompt design, retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, vector search, and API-based integration.
* Exposure to Python-based AI or machine-learning workflows, model evaluation, or analytics for anomaly detection, alert prioritization, investigation support, or false-positive reduction.
* Ability to identify responsible AI use cases while considering explainability, data privacy, security, model risk, auditability, and regulatory expectations.

**Good to have**

* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Kafka, or enterprise messaging and event-driven architecture.
* Knowledge of infrastructure as code and deployment tools such as Terraform, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or GitHub Actions.
* Experience with data platforms or processing tools such as Spark, Databricks, or cloud-native data services.
* Familiarity with observability tools, application performance monitoring, and structured production-support processes.
* Strong communication, estimation, technical documentation, stakeholder management, and Agile delivery skills.

**Experience And Education**

* Experience: Strictly 4+ years of relevant professional experience in software engineering, financial crime technology, Actimize delivery, application development, or production engineering.
* Eligibility: Candidates with less than 4 years of relevant professional experience will not be considered.
* Mandatory combination: Actimize, Java, SQL, cloud, and Financial Crime Compliance domain experience are all required.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Reliable Actimize enhancements and integrations delivered with production-quality Java and SQL.
* Clear understanding of the compliance objective, data lineage, operational controls, and regulatory context behind each solution.
* Ownership of design, development, testing, deployment, incident resolution, documentation, and stakeholder communication.
* Practical use of cloud and AI capabilities without compromising security, explainability, auditability, or maintainability.

**What Working At EY Offers**

* You will work on meaningful Financial Crime Technology assignments in an interdisciplinary environment that values quality, practical learning, coaching, collaboration, technical ownership, and knowledge exchange. The role provides opportunities to deepen expertise across Actimize, modern Java engineering, cloud delivery, and responsible AI-enabled solutions.
* Apply only if you meet the 4+ years requirement and all mandatory skill and domain criteria.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: .NET Technical Lead
description:
We are hiring a Backend Technical Lead – .NET with 8+ years of experience in .NET Core, C#, PostgreSQL, and AWS. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in microservices, REST APIs, healthcare integrations (HL7/FHIR, EMR/EHR), HIPAA compliance, and team leadership.

Roles & Responsibilities

* Lead backend development using .NET Core, C#, Web API, PostgreSQL, and AWS.
* Design scalable microservices architectures and secure REST APIs.
* Lead, mentor, and review the work of backend developers.
* Optimize database performance, application security, and system reliability.
* Implement healthcare integrations using HL7, FHIR, XML, and EMR/EHR systems.
* Ensure HIPAA compliance, PHI protection, and secure data handling.
* Drive technical decisions, code quality, CI/CD, and production issue resolution.
* Adhere to the organizations and clients applicable information security, confidentiality, privacy, and data protection requirements.
* Safeguard company and client information and use it responsibly, ensuring protection against unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, loss, or misuse.

Key Qualifications

* 8+ years of experience in .NET Core, C#, Web API, PostgreSQL, and AWS.
* Strong expertise in microservices architecture and RESTful API development.
* Experience with healthcare/EMR systems and HL7/FHIR/XML integrations.
* Knowledge of HIPAA compliance, data security, and PHI protection.
* Experience leading backend teams, mentoring developers, and conducting code reviews.
* Strong problem-solving, communication, and technical leadership skills
